phase_name: Propagate to task-breakdown.md - templates and worked examples

objectives.description: Add conditional Tier Justification placeholder to both phase templates; add a Tier Justification line to the interface, local, and full worked examples; confirm the examples do not contradict the Decision 2 final-phase definition

deviations.description: Confirm the example plan's own final phase still declares full and that the examples do not contradict the Decision 2 final-phase definition.
deviations.reason: Phase 3 (Password Reset) in the worked example depends only on 'Phase 1 complete', not transitively on Phase 2 -- so it fails Decision 2's final-phase test even though it is the last-listed phase. Rather than silently relying on readers to notice this, added one explanatory bullet to the example's existing Notes section stating explicitly that Phase 3 is not this example's final phase under the Decision 2 definition, which is exactly why its full tier carries a justification rather than being exempt. This resolves what would otherwise look like a contradiction without inventing a fourth example phase.
